intermediate: The selected top-left upper object's ARC color integer; the retained qualified case produces color 4.
limits: Finite protected label replay only. Intermediate values and causal interpretation are authored metadata, not independently proved. No owner acceptance or training admission.
step_a: Partition the four objects by the canonical first/last-top-row midpoint, select the upper-group object with the smallest minimum column, and read its observed color.
step_b: Stable-partition the lower-group objects so the unique object whose color equals that intermediate is copied into the lower-left output quadrant before the other lower object.
why_b_depends_on_a: The first lower object cannot be selected from position alone: B must consume A's input-derived color. Replacing color 4 with the top-right object's color 1 changes the lower-object order and therefore the final 7x7 output.
